SELECT A."NOTICE_ID" AS "NOTICE_ID" , A."TITLE" AS "TITLE" , A."CONTENT" AS "CONTENT" , DECODE(A."NOTICE_TYPE_CD", 'G', 'GENERAL', 'U', 'URGENT', 'E', 'EVENT', 'GENERAL') AS "NOTICE_TYPE" , DECODE(A."TOP_YN", 'Y', '1', '0') AS "TOP_YN" , NVL(A."VIEW_CNT", 0) AS "VIEW_CNT" , TO_CHAR(A."POST_START_DT", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "POST_START_YMD" , A."REG_ID" AS "INUSERID" , TO_CHAR(A."REG_DATE", 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS "INDATE" , A."MOD_ID" AS "LUSERID" , TO_CHAR(A."MOD_DATE", 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS "LDATE" FROM "DEMO"."NTC_NOTICE" A
ORDER BY A."NOTICE_ID" OFFSET #{_skiprows} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{_pagesize} ROWS ONLY
